How Artificial Intelligence Is Reshaping Corporate Sustainability

AI has environmental costs, but it is also changing how companies measure, model, and manage sustainability work.

  • By Paul Shannon
  • Original publication LinkedIn
  • Date May 1, 2025
  • Reading time 2 min
View original on LinkedIn ↗

About this work

Artificial intelligence has environmental costs, but it is also changing how organizations measure, forecast, and manage sustainability work. This article examines that tension for business readers rather than presenting AI as either an uncomplicated climate solution or a single source of harm.

Holding two claims at once

Useful analysis has to account for energy, water, and infrastructure demands while also examining applications in modeling, monitoring, reporting, and operational decision-making. The article’s structure keeps those claims adjacent so that one does not erase the other.

Audience and tone

Paul wrote for non-specialist business readers who need a clear map of the issue before evaluating a tool or strategy. The tone is explanatory and evidence-aware rather than promotional.

Paul’s role

Paul researched and wrote the technology-and-sustainability explainer independently.
